methods_quotes.q: Administrative coverage is the total number of doses given to the target population, divided by the estimated target population.
A measles outbreak is laboratory confirmed when 3 or more laboratory-confirmed measles IgM-positive cases occur in a health facility or district in a month
Confirmed incidence is derived from cases confirmed in laboratory testing for measles-specific IgM antibodies, and reported to AFRO.
Reported measles vaccination coverage is the proportion of children aged 9--12 months who have received MCV1.
